scripts.build:app: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode app --outDir dist-app
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:app: npm run build:app && node tools/deploy.mjs app
scripts.deploy:full: npm run build && node tools/deploy.mjs full
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.tmp/typecheck.app.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.tmp/typecheck.node.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.tmp/typecheck.test.tsbuildinfo
